note: Our own description of the page's section pattern. No copy, images, fonts or code from the source are stored or reused. The shingle hashes in shingles.json are one-way fingerprints used only to prove our wording does not overlap theirs.

sections.pattern: Sticky header: logo, grouped dropdown navigation where each link has a one-line descriptor, one primary call-to-action button.
Dark hero: eyebrow, single H1 promise, a line naming the problem, a line giving the solution, primary button that jumps to the paths.
Trust strip directly under the hero copy: short label followed by a row of names.
Three offer cards split by audience. Each has: who it is for, offer name, short description, price line, call-to-action. A one-line aside for a fourth audience follows.
Dark section: H2 and three numbered steps, then the primary button again.
Numbered showcase of everything on offer: one item visible at a time with image, category tag, number, title, text and button; counter, previous/next arrows and a numbered tab list.
Free download: cover image, H2, short pitch and an email sign-up.
Proof: H2, intro line and a grid of quote cards labelled by customer type.
Dark closing section: 'next step' eyebrow, H2, and the same three paths in a compact form.
Footer: logo, link columns, legal links, copyright line.
